code_first.q: Predict the uncompressed bitmap size in bytes.
code_first.code:
width = 20
height = 10
bitsPerPixel = 8
bytes = width * height * bitsPerPixel DIV 8
print(bytes)
p: Extend to calculate size when bitsPerPixel = 16.
code_first.a: 20×10×8÷8 = 200 bytes; doubled height -> 400 bytes; 16 bits per pixel -> 400 bytes with original dimensions.
